title: In Ukraine, data centers ‘facing increased attacks’ in recent weeks: Ex-official
summary: “Naturally, you cannot move everything underground. … So an important aspect is boosting Ukrainian anti-ballistic and anti-drone capabilities, which are already in critically short supply,” Kateryna Chernohorenko, Ukraine’s former deputy minister of defense for digital transformation, told Breaking Defense.
author: Elisabeth Gosselin-Malo
